---
title: "CSCI 121: Principles of Computer Science"
Semester: "2025-2026 Spring"
---


**Course Description**: This course introduces the perspectives and methods of computer science. 
Students learn to develop algorithms, which are step-by-step procedures for accomplishing a task. 
Students translate these algorithms into a programming language, utilizing common programming structures. 
The structures covered include variables, functions, loops, control flow, basic data structures, 
classes, and a brief introduction to object-oriented programming.
